How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 06-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MDU Rohtak Field Investigator position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Field Investigator post at MDU Rohtak is 06 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Field Investigator role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate degree in any social science discipline along with an M.Ed, securing a minimum of 55% marks.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify an age limit for this recruitment. It is advisable to check the detailed notification for any specific age criteria.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Field Investigator position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 20,000.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the MDU Rohtak Field Investigator job?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. Ensure you prepare your application with all necessary documents and send it before the deadline.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Field Investigator position at MDU Rohtak will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q7. Are there any application fees for this post?
faq.answer: No, there are no application fees mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Field Investigator at Maharshi Dayanand University Rohtak.

faq.question: Q9. When is the interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The interview for the Field Investigator position is scheduled to take place on 10 September 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.
